entityDefinitions.name: Tug Class II

entityDefinitions.name: Vega Class

entityDefinitions.name: Aries Class

entityDefinitions.name: Ambassador Class

entityDefinitions.name: Hideki Class

entityDefinitions.name: Delpin Warship

entityDefinitions.name: Bajoran Sailing Ship

entityDefinitions.name: Vulcan Explorer

entityDefinitions.name: Intrepid Class

weaponDefinitions.description: An alien beam weapon, that can cut through a ship like a hot knife through butter.

weaponDefinitions.description: These rapid fire disruptors will cut through any ship quick, but are only forward-firing.

weaponDefinitions.name: Type VII Phaser
weaponDefinitions.description: Fires a rapid succession of small phaser blasts.

weaponDefinitions.name: Transphasic Torpedo

weaponDefinitions.name: Polaron Torpedo

weaponDefinitions.name: Tachyon Field Generator

weaponDefinitions.name: Tractor Beam
weaponDefinitions.description: Locks onto a target and holds it there.

weaponDefinitions.name: Thaleron Generator

weaponDefinitions.name: Magnetorp Launcher

planet.description: The Homeworld of the humans and the center of government for the Earth Empire. Earth's population has slowly declined as much of its people are sent to their deaths in the war with the Klingons. All of the human's resources have been spent on the war and the cities of Earth have fallen into disrepair. Even so, most humans are not willing to leave the one place they call home.

The Vulcans were once a fierce race along side the humans. But after significant cultural reforms they retreated to their homeworld and have become primarily educators. Their universities and research facilities are top-notch. They have a small fleet of ships but have very few weapons.

Founded a few hundred years ago by passivist humans, New Switzerland has grown into a large economic center for their region of the galaxy. After the Imperial War began New Switzerland became a safe-haven for humans escaping the Klingon onslaught. The Swiss make the best laser cutters in the galaxy.
Far from the human territory is HofMaso, the primary shipyard of the Klingon Empire. It is here that they secretly developed a massive fleet for over a 50 years to overthrow Earth's power.

Homeworld to the Ferengi race, who are mostly traders of various goods and services. The Ferengi will sell you anything they can get their hands on, but are usually reluctant to buy. Their primary trade ship is their small cargo shuttle, but they also have large Maurauder starships that are quite combat capable.
The primary world of the Romulan race. They are a xenophobic race who are unwilling to communicate freely with outside governments.
A once beautiful world stripped of its resources and covered on nearly 84 percent of its surface with artificial buildings. It has a population density greater than any known planet in the galaxy.

The site of a great war between the Earth Empire and a conquering race called the Dominion. Earth destroyed the invading Dominion fleet and they were driven to this planet where a few survivors went unnoticed and are slowly rebuilding.

The Vex homeworld. Once a thriving civilization, the planet is all but destroyed. Skeletons litter the ground, and you feel a strange presence here as if someone is watching you. A few broken hulls in orbit of this planet tell you that this is not the place to be.

The first planet to be colonized by humans, it remains one of the power centers of the empire. Much of Earth's administration has been moved to Alpha Centauri since Earth is under constant threat of attack. Fortunately this planet has gone relatively untouched in the war and it remains a beautiful planet with a dense population.

The homeworld of the Klingon race. It is here that the first uprising began against the tyranny of the humans. The system is now heavily guarded and with the slow spread of Klingon power across the quadrant it is unlikely Earth will ever retake it.

This planet contains one of the most heaviest Klingon populations with the exception of Qonos, despite its frequent volcanic eruptions. It is also considered to be the worst side of the empire, with many untrustworthy Klingon captains making frequent port calls here.

The humans quickly annexed the planet Orion to take full advantage of the already-existing slave trade here. Though Orions are not good laborers, they do make fine administrators and secretaries. Over 80% of the beauracratic system on Earth is operated by Orion slaves. Because of their importance, Orions live a privileged life with many benefits over other slaves such as the Lysians.

The inhabitants of Lik Prime were most surprised when they came under the rule of the Earth Empire. As a pre-warp civilization the sudden transition nearly tore their society apart. The planet is mostly desert with some tropical regions, but with frequent human strip-mining the water on this planet is toxic and they rely entirely on other sources.

A planet that was once home to a wide variety of life, it was strip-mined by the humans until it eventually became uninhabitable. Nothing can live on its surface now and it is an utterly useless planet.

A prison planet for the Earth Empire. It still has several hundred thousand prisoners of various races. The planet has been ignored for the most part of the war, even though the Klingons know there are a good many Klingons still being held prisoner there. Anyone who visits this world will not be able to sleep at night, as the blood-curling screams from the prisoners being tortured by their human guards echo in the deep canyons nonstop.

A great experiment that failed, Epsilon was supposed to be a peaceful human colony. Instead, the people here continued the human tradition of malignity. It was abandoned, an only a handful of people remain trapped in a 22nd century ideal, clinging to the 'old times'.
Quintus has served as an Earth outpost since the beginning of the Imperial War. It supports a small population of civilians and houses many millions of soldiers who train here.

Rigel is an independent planet inhabited by a primitive industrial society. The Andorians however lay claim to this world and are quite willing to protect it and its people. The people here are so peaceful it would be a shame to ruin them.

A peaceful settlement with a variety of races. Many people from different governments get along here, even though they may be at war with each other. It is said that this might be due to the high number of Polock Flowers that bloom on the surface year-round. Its pollen has a calming affect on the average humanoid's senses. One person even claims to have seen a Klingon and a Human holding hands.

The primitive Lysians were used by the humans as laborers for the strip-mining of Paso. With the onset of the war the Lysians finally found themselves free. But since their technology is so primitive, they do not dare venture out of their territory. Many regard the Lysians as children and wish no harm against them. The Lysians however are enjoying their momentary freedom and just hope no one comes along to enslave them again any time soon.

Once combat warriors for the Earth Empire, the Nausicans are now free. However they have no ships of their own and most are simple independent traders. Nausica itself is a fairly ugly world with ugly people. Not many people bother coming here.

Tholians managed to save themselves from enslavement by being, frankly, the best ship designers the galaxy has ever known. Now that Earth has dropped its funding for Tholian technology, they produce only one class of trade ship, but it is still the most widely used ship on the civilian market.

The Flashians are incredible computer programmers. They supply many governments with computer systems and software for the ships of their fleets and are contracted often by the Tholians and Andorians. One can only sit in wonder at the genious and pure sexiness of the Flash programmers.

OceNu has historically been a battleground between the Klingons and the Humans, as it is equidistant between their homeworlds. The small population usually stayed unharmed and out of the way, but the constant battles raging in space limits any interstellar travel here.

Koann was originally a shipyard for Earth's Imperial Fleet. At its peak there were 30 stations in orbit producing 180 starships a year. It was the first planet to be taken by the Klingons and has since been converted into a spy post for the Klingon Empire.
Home to a race of pre-industrial aliens. It is only due to their extreme insignificance that they have managed to go unnoticed by any advanced species.

The Delpi homeworld is over 99.8 water and is home to a highly intelligent aquatic dolphin-like race. Their technology is quite advanced but lacks any strong weapon designs. Their aquatic ships are fast and sleek and, until recently, were scientific long-range explorers for the humans. Now they enjoy the freedom to do as they please.

Primarily ship builders, Andorians of Andoria rival the Ferengi in their lust for wealth. They sell ships to just about anyone, and frequently sell to both sides of a warring party at low prices with the idea that the longer the war continues the more sales they will have. Thus, the Andorians are both hated and loved by the humans, who buy ships from them yet watch as they sell the same ships to the Klingons.

Trills are considered the sexiest of all the species. Trill women dominate the prostitution market second only to the Orion Slave Trade. And yes, their spots do go all the way down, and for a few slips of latinum you can find out for yourself.
The Teposians are weapons dealers, plain and simple. They've built their entire economy around it and are making a killing during the war. Care to buy some?
One of the homeworlds of the Romulan Empire. This planet is home to the Remans, who are a slave race to the Romulans. They mine dilithium here on this planet for the profit of the Romulan Empire.

This planet used to belong to the Earth Empire until it was abandoned when the Klingons began their rise to power. It was thought that since it was so close to the Klingons it would be lost anyway. Now it has its own government.
An Earth planet that was quickly overtaken by the Klingon Empire at the beginning of the Imperial War. It serves as little but a small military outpost.

Named after a great warrior who is said to have saved the Klingons from losing the war with his brilliant tactics and war strategies. Worf is a relatively peaceful Klingon planet, although there are frequent public human disembowelments from time to time.

A barren rock that the Klingons stripmine for resources such as duranium to build their warships. Xonok has a population of zero and cannot support any life due to the heavy toxins now in its atmosphere.

Once a thriving metropolis planet, Qem-Kis is all but abandoned now that the Klingon Empire has extended to its borders and driven out all the humans. Now only the seething criminals and mercinaries remain.

A diverse world with many different species of wildlife. Many civilians come here to hunt or gather fresh food for long journeys. At night you can hear the mating call of the Praedis Monkey, who have been known to trample over hikers in their frenzy to find a female Praedis.

A Klingon world not frequently travelled in. DuQot has few services to offer anyone and as such, does not generally receive too many visitors. There are some black market ship trades here, but none that draw the attention of the Empire.

Despite numerous attempts to colonize this world by the Klingons, Nyoabek's unsuitable landscape and atmosphere have made it impossible for anyone to gain a foothold. There are some awkwardly built trade outposts on its surface, but no one is willing to live here.
Named after the great Klingon Warrior Kah'Less, this world is dismal and trecherous. Many Klingon warriors are sent here to train.
A desert planet with little to no vegetation and primitive life forms. There are no sentient indigenous peoples here, but several colonies are scattered in various small oasises.
Erasariel is so far from its sun that it is a frozen wasteland. But since it has atmosphere, many people settle here under artificial means.

A reptillian species that threatened Earth. Their military fleet, and indeed their entire race, was wiped out by the Earth Empire a few hundred years ago. The outer skin of the Gorn does not decompose, and it is perhaps the billions of corpses scattered across the planet that has caused this planet to go unpopulated.

A beautiful planet with a great variety of wildlife. The waterfalls here on Denmark are some of the tallest in the galaxy. It is said that a primitive sentient race once thrived here but later died out of natural causes.

The Iconians were an ancient race that no longer inhabit this planet. A war-like species, they were annihilated by their enemies thousands of years ago. Many archaeological expeditions have taken place on Iconia, and some fascinating artifacts have been found. But the decimation of their world was efficient and complete, and so very little of their society remains.
Although a reasonably pleasant planet with a few resources and life forms, none of the major governments colonized this small world.

A planet that was home to a peaceful early-warp civilization. They were in relatively peaceful contact with their close neighbors the Romulans. But after the Vex system was destroyed, Harman soon vanished. The entire planet is now a frozen wasteland. Many say the Romulans know what happened to Harman, but they refuse to tell anyone.
